column1: # Routing group catalog. One row per group the deployment ensures.
# id|members|routing|stays|listed|purpose
# id        the group name an agent selects as "group/<id>".
# members   comma-separated model roles, or "group/<id>" for another group, in
#           the order the gateway tries them. A model role may carry a fixed
#           reasoning effort as "role:<effort>", where the effort is one of
#           none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max; the effort is
#           appended to every model id the role resolves to. A group reference
#           carries no effort, because a group keeps its own routing.
# routing   the routing mode. drain spends a member's accounts until they are
#           used up, moves to the next member, and never returns to an earlier
#           one. It is Magpie's "Until used up".
# stays     the stay mode. auto lets the gateway decide.
# listed    yes when the group appears in an agent's picker, no when it stays
#           reachable only as another group's member.
# purpose   what the group is for.
chatgpt|chatgpt.sol,chatgpt.terra|drain|auto|yes|weekly ChatGPT quota
openai-stack|group/chatgpt,openai.sol,openai.terra,conductor.kimi:max|drain|auto|yes|weekly, then API, then Kimi max
conductor|group/openai-stack|drain|auto|yes|Claude Code
workhorse|workhorse.minimax,conductor.deepseek|drain|auto|yes|Pi and dsh
